Behavior & Comms Score 3.0: Definitive Overhaul Blueprint
15 Oct @ 3:16pm
Azure
Originally posted by v6.0WasBetter:
Originally posted by Skiv#fixBehavior:
It’s funny how the current system is mostly defended by noobs, account buyers, boosted players, and, ironically enough, toxic ones
100%

The current uncalibrated framework is highly exploitable by specific demographics. It allows mass reports to be blindly accepted as inherently valid when they shouldn't be, simply because Valve still lacks a baseline verification filter to process text & voice telemetry. Consequently, bad-faith actors and low-tier players can exploit these automated processing layers as a tool for proxy abuse, completely derailing actual matchmaking telemetry
